verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a model gallery (Discover page, `local-ai models list`), automatic GPU detection for choosing a backend, and a `local-ai chat` shell agent. None of it documents an AI assistant that recommends a model to fit the user's hardware and task before download. GPU auto-detection picks a backend, not a model, and the chat agent is a general-purpose assistant, so both are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
